meta.tagline: See the patterns that shape your connections
meta.defaultTitle: Understand Your Relationship Patterns and Inner World
meta.defaultDescription: Gentle reflections that help you see your patterns, understand your reactions, and feel safer and clearer in your relationships.
meta.keywords: relationship patterns, self-awareness, emotional patterns, personal reflections, emotional intelligence, relationship clarity, communication patterns

hero.headline: You're not broken. You're patterned.
hero.subheadline: Understand why it feels hard to feel safe, open up fully, or stay yourself in a relationship — and what your patterns are quietly trying to protect.
hero.tagline: Personal, private reflections that turn your patterns into words you can actually understand and use.

hook.headline: What You'll Discover
hook.tagline: No labels. No diagnoses. Just clear recognition.

discoveries.title: Understanding for why you feel the way you do
discoveries.description: "I shut down when there's pressure for closeness" stops being a flaw — it becomes a pattern you can notice, understand, and work with.

discoveries.title: Clarity on when and how to respond
discoveries.description: See how you show care, how you tend to pull back or protect yourself, and what helps you feel safer in connection.

discoveries.title: A private space for your own reflections
discoveries.description: Explore real situations from your life with a reflection companion that feels human, warm, and on your side.

discoveries.title: Awareness of how your patterns affect others
discoveries.description: With a partner, notice how your rhythms meet, where you miss each other, and how to move toward a more balanced dynamic.

step1.title: Reflect
step1.description: Answer a few thoughtful questions about how you relate to yourself and others. They reveal the patterns underneath your reactions.

step2.title: Understand
step2.description: Your answers turn into a warm, personal reflection that explains your emotional patterns in clear, everyday language.

step3.title: Explore
step3.description: When something real comes up, talk to your reflection companion about it. It remembers your patterns and helps you notice what's happening inside you.

step4.title: Connect
step4.description: When you're ready, invite your partner. Your reflections stay private — only shared insights reveal where you align, where you miss, and how to meet in the middle.

triedBefore.headline: You've Tried to Understand Yourself Before
triedBefore.intro: You’ve explored ideas like attachment styles, communication habits, and love languages. They made sense in theory — but it’s harder to see how they show up in real moments.
triedBefore.insight: What’s been missing is a reflection that speaks your language.
triedBefore.description: Withinly turns complex psychological ideas into clear, familiar examples and everyday language you can recognize from your own life.

testimonials.quote: For the first time, I could clearly name what I do wrong when things get tense. It helped me see my reactions more clearly and understand what I can shift to stay calmer.
testimonials.author: Sara

testimonials.quote: Withinly helped me see myself from the outside and understand my patterns and behaviour much more clearly. I especially loved the option to sync with my partner - it gave us both more clarity and helped us see how we can improve the way we communicate with each other.
testimonials.author: Monika

items.question: Is this therapy?
items.answer: No. Withinly helps you see your patterns — therapy helps you heal. Many therapists appreciate when clients bring this kind of clarity into sessions.

items.question: What if I'm single?
items.answer: Perfect. Understanding your patterns now changes how you show up later, whether with a future partner, friends, or family.

items.question: How private is this?
items.answer: Your reflections stay yours. Even with partner sync, only shared insights are visible — never your individual answers or conversations.

items.question: How much will Withinly cost?
items.answer: You can start exploring for free. During early access, you’ll receive a generous amount of insights to try the full experience. When we launch, deeper reflections and advanced features will be available as small, optional one-time purchases. No subscriptions. No hidden fees. You only pay for what truly feels meaningful to you.
